title: Reduce WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1
description: Halved weight decay regularization for Muon-optimized transformer matrices
reflection: Result: val_bpb 0.996000 (baseline 0.996000, no change). Hypothesis failed. Weight decay is not a convergence bottleneck. Regularization strength at 0.2 is already optimal for this setup. Rounds 2-5 show we've saturated on optimizer tuning (MATRIX_LR) and regularization (WEIGHT_DECAY). Future rounds should explore batch size, architecture variants, or entirely different hyperparameter families (warmup schedules, embedding learning rates in isolation, or scheduler changes).
